label: Blind sample burn null 001: tree-covered land >= 5 km from any MTBS perimeter, near VA

verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.03 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 14 Nov 2019 (90% interval −0.07 to +0.06). The same test was run on 45 untouched control cells. In 10 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.24). Counted by gap size instead, 10 of the 45 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.24). The interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out.
reasons: the interval is too wide to rule a meaningful change in or out

evidence.sentence: Neither optical nor radar shows a change beyond what the controls did.
